answer: Splitting into 9 separate vaults requires a separate funded basalt account and a separate escrow deposit for each, which means the capital requirement multiplies while the influence does not. The harbor explorer makes public the whole merge tree. Mining keys can be linked to a custody vault, and the link is an on-ledger identity transaction: once linked, every key under that vault is one entity with one vote and one jury seat. That is 21 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
